title: Causal Edge Transport Reorders Turbulent Plume Evidence Before Bayesian Search
hook: Exact horizon-2 lookahead can lose to myopic search when it plans through a misordered likelihood field; a smaller intervention is to replace global sample comparison with causal transport over the evidence already available. The proposal adds no planning depth, learned model, new House, or new seed.
hook_shape_rationale: Counter-intuitive minimalism: relative to exact horizon-2 information gain, the candidate is strictly no larger on planning depth and uses only frozen M1/M2 fields plus the realized observation prefix, while targeting the upstream source-order metric that the 22/106 result implicates. A structural-reframe hook was also viable because arxiv:2605.13208v1 globally ranks accumulated concentrations, but it was rejected because the user-supplied failed-lookahead contrast gives a sharper admission test than redescribing temporal exchangeability as tacit.

gap_closure.gap: At the frontier leaf represented by arxiv:2605.13208v1, no retrieved work establishes whether candidate-source ordering remains valid when a single-UAV trajectory samples a turbulent plume whose observed-to-modeled relation changes across intermittent regimes rather than remaining globally monotone — stakes: a source can be ranked below a geometrically incompatible rival before accumulation, wasting the fixed flight budget and making conclusions from monotone-sensor evaluations fail to transfer to held-out GADEN houses.
gap_closure.how_closed: The gap is closed by reframing candidate support as a lexicographic monotone-transport attribution over causal observation/field edges, then using a pre-cost temporal-pairing intervention—not a permutation of already-scored values—to supply the companion's confound-isolating offline gate.

core_mechanism: For each causally available observation edge i=(t-1,t) in the existing completed-run ledger and current prefix, form an observation token (i/n, u_i, a_i), where u_i=sign(y_t-y_{t-1}) and a_i=|y_t-y_{t-1}| divided by the total absolute observation change in that run. For candidate s, form g_{s,t}=log((Lsrc_{s,t}+epsilon_machine)/(Lcar_{s,t}+epsilon_machine)) from the frozen source and carrier likelihood fields, then the field token (i/n, v_{s,i}, b_{s,i}) with v_{s,i}=sign(g_{s,t}-g_{s,t-1}) and b_{s,i}=|g_{s,t}-g_{s,t-1}| divided by its run total; epsilon_machine is the floating-point machine constant, not a tuned parameter. The central object O_s is the order-preserving transport coupling between observation mass a and candidate-field mass b, computed independently inside each causal run and concatenated over the prefix. Its score T_s=(Cdir_s,Ctime_s) is lexicographic: first minimize transported mass joining opposite directions, then, among direction-optimal couplings, minimize normalized temporal displacement |i/n-j/n|; magnitude is retained as transported mass, and no scalar weight bridges the two criteria. One-dimensional monotone transport gives O_s and T_s by a deterministic cumulative-mass scan, so every candidate is comparable without a learned decoder, calibrated threshold, distance penalty, or planner-weight change. Candidates are sorted by ascending T_s, ties retain their baseline order, and the current baseline likelihood-value multiset is reassigned in descending order to that candidate order before Bayesian accumulation and before any action score is computed; the value multiset is unchanged while candidate identity ordering may change. If a prefix has fewer than one edge with nonzero observation and field mass, M3 is the identity for that prefix rather than inventing evidence. For the preregistered control, each completed run's candidate-field token values are cyclically shifted by delta_r=floor(n_r/2) while their time coordinates and all observation tokens stay fixed, and O_s/T_s are recomputed from the altered pair costs; because intervention occurs before pairing and T_s is order-sensitive, this null is not algebraically invariant to its own operation. Source identities remain sequestered until baseline, aligned-transport, and shifted-control candidate orders have all been frozen.
core_mechanism_reasoning:
BLOCK 1 — PREMISES ledger:
P1. On the frozen realized path, the true candidate's source-over-carrier field transitions retain temporally ordered local agreement with GADEN concentration transitions even when absolute observed-to-modeled levels are not globally monotone — untested — falsification target.
P2. Transporting normalized transition mass within causal runs preserves discriminative timing and magnitude that global concentration ranks discard; the direction-first lexicographic objective is justified because a same-direction transition is the minimal source-support event, while time displacement only resolves direction-preserving alternatives — untested — falsification target.
P3. The existing source/carrier likelihood pair is an internal contrast with stable semantics under frozen M1/M2; no source truth is needed to compute g_{s,t}.
OBSERVATION-MODEL premise. Samples come from an adaptively chosen, non-IID single-UAV path with intermittent censoring; the method conditions on the realized timestamps, positions, and causal run boundaries and does not assume that the sampled edges are unbiased draws from a stationary plume.
ESTIMAND. At prefix k, T_s(k) is exactly the empirical lexicographic minimum (opposite-direction transported mass, normalized temporal displacement) between observed concentration-change mass and candidate-s source-over-carrier-change mass over the causally observed run prefixes; the offline evaluation estimand is the change in true-source pairwise ordering frequency over the fixed 106 H02/H03 comparisons after all truth-blind orders are frozen.
BLOCK 2 — NAIVE-BASELINE AUDIT:
The naive runnable version pools all observed and modeled values and ranks a candidate by global rank agreement or one pooled correlation. Branch (i): it silently assumes samples are exchangeable under one stationary monotone relation, which is false in the target setting when intermittent regimes and adaptive motion change that relation; Causal Edge Transport confronts this by making ordered transition atoms and within-run coupling the scored object rather than adding cosmetics to a pooled statistic. STANDARD-TOOL FOLLOW-UP: monotone transport and sequence alignment are textbook tools, but this instance couples adaptively sampled observation edges to paired source-versus-carrier field edges, must preserve the incumbent likelihood multiset at the Bayesian interface, and must expose a pairing-breaking no-truth null; that constrained object and interface are the domain-specific contribution rather than an off-the-shelf distance. The design deliberately avoids the occupied ancestral routes of global empirical ranks, covariance whitening, Huber residual clipping, CUSUM segmentation, and ABC tolerance selection.
BLOCK 3 — DESIGN RATIONALE:
The anchor is kept as one deep gap because a separate correlation-regime or stationarity module is not required to run or falsify the ordering operator; the controlled diagnostic earns its seat only as the companion intervention on the same transport object. Windowed correlation, change-point segmentation, and learned calibration were rejected because they respectively regress to occupied covariance/CUSUM nodes or introduce tuning and access beyond the frozen fields. A likelihood-multiset interface is retained from the salvageable prior attempt, but the failed symmetric replication statistic and its invariant run permutation are replaced by an order-sensitive pre-pairing construction and null.
core_mechanism_steps:
1. Read the frozen M1/M2 source likelihood Lsrc_{s,t}, carrier likelihood Lcar_{s,t}, GADEN concentration y_t, timestamp, position, and existing causal run identifier for every candidate s on the realized prefix; output a schema-checked prefix table without source truth.
2. Within each run and current causal prefix, difference adjacent y values and adjacent candidate log source-over-carrier contrasts g_{s,t}; output signed transition sequences plus normalized nonnegative masses a_i and b_{s,i}.
3. For every candidate, build the ordered observation and field token lists and their direction-mismatch and normalized time-displacement pair costs; output the candidate-specific transport instance.
4. Solve the lexicographic one-dimensional monotone transport by cumulative mass scanning; output O_s and T_s=(Cdir_s,Ctime_s) for every candidate, with explicit zero-mass status flags.
5. Stable-sort candidates by ascending T_s while preserving the baseline order on exact ties; output the truth-blind candidate permutation.
6. Stable-sort the current baseline likelihood values and assign them to the candidate permutation from step 5; output the multiset-preserving M3 likelihood vector that is passed directly to the unchanged Bayesian accumulator and then to the unchanged action selector.
7. In the offline gate only, cyclically shift each completed run's candidate-field token values by delta_r=floor(n_r/2) before rebuilding costs, rerun steps 3–6, and output the shifted-pairing negative-control vector; runs without a nonzero shift are marked non-informative rather than silently pooled.
8. Freeze hashes of the baseline, aligned-transport, and shifted-control vectors for all fixed H02/H03 comparisons, then let the sequestered evaluator reveal source identities and compute the preregistered downstream ordering metric.
falsification_prediction: Replay the fixed 106 H02/H03 comparisons with frozen M1/M2 and the realized paths under three truth-blind arms: myopic baseline, aligned Causal Edge Transport M3, and the half-run cyclic-shift control; freeze all candidate orders before the sequestered GADEN source identities are read. If the mechanism works, held-out true-source pairwise ordering win rate for aligned transport increases relative to myopic, without a preregistered numeric outcome bar. The single load-bearing variable is the aligned candidate-by-edge transport object O_s together with its lexicographic score T_s. As a negative-control intervention, shifting candidate-field token values before pair-cost construction must move the downstream true-source ordering win rate back toward or below myopic; failure of that return, or equality of every aligned and shifted T_s despite nonconstant inputs, falsifies the claimed temporal-pairing mechanism and blocks runtime integration.
compute_budget: 0.2 80GB-GPU-day equivalent for implementation checks and the full fixed 106-comparison replay; the transport and hashing path is CPU-bound, so no model training is required. $0 API cost for the full campaign.

differentiation_from_lit.delta: The abstract describes global empirical ranks of accumulated measured and modeled concentrations, whereas this candidate constructs an order-sensitive, magnitude-carrying monotone transport over causal observation/source-carrier edges and an explicit pre-pairing null.

The abstract compares an accumulated probabilistic gas-hit map with online dispersion simulations, whereas this candidate attributes each causal concentration-transition mass to candidate-specific source-over-carrier transitions before Bayesian accumulation without constructing a new map.

The abstract changes the action policy from myopic information gain to far-sighted reinforcement learning while retaining a fixed plume likelihood, whereas this candidate leaves planning unchanged and replaces the upstream candidate ordering delivered to it.

what_step_was_missed: It would have needed to preserve causal adjacency and magnitude, construct a candidate-specific ordered coupling between observation transitions and source-over-carrier field transitions, and falsify that coupling by breaking the pairings before recomputing the score rather than globally ranking accumulated values.
